# CRAN (Comprehensive R Archive Network)

> The official repository for R packages, providing access to thousands of vetted packages, build tools, and comprehensive documentation for the R statistical computing ecosystem.

CRAN is the primary distribution network for R packages and tools, serving the global R community with package hosting, installation guides, and development resources. It maintains strict quality standards and provides infrastructure for building R from source across multiple platforms.

## Key Topics

- R programming language
- CRAN packages
- Package installation
- Google Sheets API
- Data access
- API wrappers
- Windows toolchain
- RTools
- Build from source
- Spreadsheet interaction
- Posit Software
- Package dependencies

## Package Repository

- [CRAN: Package googlesheets4](https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/googlesheets4/index.html): googlesheets4 R package for accessing Google Sheets via Sheets API V4, enabling programmatic interaction with spreadsheets

## Build Tools & Installation

- [RTools: Toolchains for building R and R packages from source on Windows](https://cran.r-project.org/bin/windows/Rtools/): RTools installation guide for building R packages from source on Windows, providing essential compilation toolchains
